interpretations: Return exactly 10 playlists with the highest track-count-to-average ratio, where the average includes every playlist, including empty playlists.
Return exactly 10 playlists with the highest track-count-to-average ratio, where the average includes only playlists that contain at least one track.
Return all playlists tied at the tenth-highest ratio, using an average that includes empty playlists.
Return all playlists tied at the tenth-highest ratio, using an average that excludes empty playlists.
Select the 10 playlists with the most tracks, then display each count divided by the average across all playlists; place undefined ratios last.
Select the 10 playlists with the most tracks, then display each count divided by the average across nonempty playlists; place undefined ratios last.
queries:
WITH playlist_counts AS (
  SELECT p.PlaylistId, p.Name, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS track_count
  FROM Playlist AS p
  LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack AS pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId
  GROUP BY p.PlaylistId, p.Name
)
SELECT PlaylistId, Name,
       track_count * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(track_count) FROM playlist_counts) AS track_count_to_average_ratio
FROM playlist_counts
ORDER BY track_count_to_average_ratio DESC, PlaylistId
LIMIT 10

WITH track_counts AS (
  SELECT PlaylistId, COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM PlaylistTrack
  GROUP BY PlaylistId
)
SELECT p.PlaylistId, p.Name,
       tc.track_count * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(track_count) FROM track_counts) AS ratio
FROM Playlist AS p
JOIN track_counts AS tc ON tc.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId
ORDER BY ratio DESC, p.PlaylistId
LIMIT 10

WITH playlist_counts AS (
  SELECT p.PlaylistId, p.Name, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS track_count
  FROM Playlist AS p
  LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack AS pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId
  GROUP BY p.PlaylistId, p.Name
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    PlaylistId,
    Name,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      ORDER BY track_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(AVG(track_count) OVER (), 0) DESC
    ) AS ratio_rank
  FROM playlist_counts
)
SELECT PlaylistId, Name
FROM ranked
WHERE ratio_rank = 10

WITH playlist_counts AS (
    SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS track_count
    FROM Playlist AS p
    JOIN PlaylistTrack AS pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId
    GROUP BY p.PlaylistId
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        PlaylistId,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            ORDER BY track_count * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(track_count) FROM playlist_counts) DESC
        ) AS ratio_rank
    FROM playlist_counts
)
SELECT p.*
FROM Playlist AS p
JOIN ranked AS r ON r.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId
WHERE r.ratio_rank = 10;

WITH playlist_counts AS (
    SELECT p.PlaylistId, p.Name, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS track_count
    FROM Playlist AS p
    LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack AS pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId
    GROUP BY p.PlaylistId
),
top_playlists AS (
    SELECT PlaylistId, Name, track_count
    FROM playlist_counts
    ORDER BY track_count DESC, PlaylistId
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT
    Name,
    track_count * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(track_count) FROM playlist_counts), 0) AS ratio
FROM top_playlists
ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC, PlaylistId

WITH playlist_counts AS (
  SELECT p.PlaylistId, p.Name, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS track_count
  FROM Playlist AS p
  LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack AS pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId
  GROUP BY p.PlaylistId, p.Name
),
top_playlists AS (
  SELECT PlaylistId, Name, track_count
  FROM playlist_counts
  ORDER BY track_count DESC, PlaylistId
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT
  Name,
  track_count * 1.0 / (
    SELECT AVG(track_count)
    FROM playlist_counts
    WHERE track_count > 0
  ) AS ratio
FROM top_playlists
ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC, PlaylistId
